title: Credit Desk Guidance on Earlier Payment Plans (Insulin Pump Program)
content:
The plan-history change of a new payment plan on an Insulin Pump Program follows the program's earlier payment plans, read from the payment plan requests on the program received in the 24 months (the plan-history lookback) before the acceptance date:

- where a payment plan on the program was withdrawn in that time, 2 months (the withdrawn-plan reduction) are taken off the plan months;
- where none was withdrawn in that time and a payment plan on the program was completed in that time, 1 month (the completed-plan extension) is added;
- otherwise nothing changes.

A record counts as in a number of months before today, the acceptance date, when its date is later than the same day of the month that many months before today, so a record dated exactly 24 months before today is outside the lookback. A withdrawn plan in the lookback decides the change even when a completed plan is also in the lookback.

| Payment plans on the program in the 24 months before acceptance | Effect on the plan months |
|---|---|
| a withdrawn plan (with or without a completed plan) | 2 months taken off |
| a completed plan, no withdrawn plan | 1 month added |
| neither | no change |

*Boundary reading (hypothetical, acceptance on 15 June):* a withdrawn plan received on 16 June two years earlier is in the lookback; one received on 15 June two years earlier is not.
